title: One-Bit Verifier: source of truth is SPEC_one_bit_verifier.md
body: SPEC_one_bit_verifier.md (v0.1) at project root is authoritative. Invariants V0–V6 (§1) are permanent; any change requires an ADR and is presumed wrong. Key gates: T2 proving benchmark decides Option A (Longfellow monolithic) vs Option B (Noir/UltraHonk recursive) at ≤2.5s p50 / ≤6s p95 on reference low-end device → record as ADR-003. Build sequence T1–T6 tracked as sentinel issues under EPIC-0001.
